Thought: The carbon chemical shifts from the HSQC data can be matched with the retrieved shift ranges to identify functional groups. The shift at 52.2 ppm corresponds to an RH2C-O group, indicating a methoxy or similar ether group. The shifts between 125.5 and 130.1 ppm are consistent with aromatic carbons (Ar-H). The molecular formula C8H6O10 suggests multiple carboxylic acid or ester groups, which typically have shifts between 160-180 ppm, but these are not directly observed in the HSQC data, possibly due to the absence of directly attached protons. The presence of chlorine and the mass spectrometry data suggest a chlorinated aromatic compound. Based on this information, I will deduce possible fragments and their SMILES strings.
